# Telix to Host Capital Markets Day in Melbourne on November 4, 2026


**Melbourne (Australia) and Indianapolis, IN (United States) | October 9, 2026**


Telix today advises that it will host a Capital Markets Day in Melbourne, Australia, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. (AEDT).


Institutional investors and analysts are invited to attend the in-person event, which will provide an update on Telix’s commercial portfolio, late-stage pipeline and strategic growth opportunities. Members of the Telix leadership team will present at the event, which will also feature key opinion leaders who will provide their perspectives on Telix’s theranostic programs.


Advance registration is required for in-person attendance. To register your interest please contactcharlene.jaw@telixpharma.com orannie.kasparian@telixpharma.com .


The event will be webcast live and available via the Investor Relations section of the Telix website.
